messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-XYZ789 — prod-router: latency_p95 > 450ms (3x in 2m). Alert context: region=us-west-2, model-route=gen-medium, sample_rate=1
oncall-ryan: acked. I'm taking this. :wave: checking console now. any customer tickets?
prod-support: none yet, no 500s in Sentry. only elevated latency spikes.
oncall-ryan: dashboards show a 30s tail at the edge right when the pages hit, then it drops. ingest rate looks normal. linking traces: https://console.redwood/example/trace/abc123
sre-ana: looks like a brief spike around 03:12 UTC, correlates with a canary rollout job that kicks off every 15m. saw similar pattern last month. could be KV cache churn.
oncall-ryan: good call. i'm running a quick grep on router logs; pulling tail:
```
curl -s 'https://logs.redwood/api/query?start=-5m&query=router.latency%20%3E%20400' | jq '.hits|.[]|{ts,latency,route}'
```
infra-nikhil: also seeing autoscaler oscillation in the dedicated pool around the same timestamps — short-lived scale up then back down. might increase p95 if warm caches miss.
oncall-ryan: agree. tenant metrics show KV-hit-rate dipped to 62% for ~40s. that would explain token expansion and higher latency for first few requests.
sre-ana: i'd lean towards suppressing the noisy alert for 10m and add a follow-up to adjust alerting to ignore short blips (<1m sustained). want to avoid PD churn.
oncall-ryan: +1. i'll add a temporary silence on the PD escalation policy for 10m and keep monitoring. executing silence now: `pd silence create --service PD-XYZ789 --duration 10m --note "transient kv warmup; triage"`
pagerduty: Silence created by oncall-ryan for 10 minutes on service PD-XYZ789.
incident-bot: Alert PD-XYZ789 auto-resolved (reason: metric below threshold).
prod-support: thanks — still no customer reports, looks non-impacting.
sre-ana: can we add a small guard in the alert rule to require two contiguous buckets 30s each? that'll cut these one-off flutters. I'll file a tiny alert PR after we confirm root cause.
oncall-ryan: filing the PR and leaving a note in the runbook: "if kv prefill + autoscaler oscillation coincide, treat as transient unless errors surface"
infra-nikhil: FYI I pushed a tweak to the autoscaler cooldown in staging (increase cooldown from 30s -> 90s) — want to see if that prevents thrash. will watch tomorrow's cadence.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired again: PD-XYZ789 — prod-router: latency_p95 > 450ms (1x). (auto-suppressed by active silence)
oncall-ryan: saw the second firing but silence prevented escalation. good. keeping an eye for recurrence.
prod-support: pinging back if anything customer-facing shows up. will escalate otherwise.
sre-ana: marking this as "transient-flap/no-customer-impact" in the incident tracker and closing the thread unless it flaps again in the next 30m. :white_check_mark:
